state:
Goal `core-regex-and-1-more`. Every `Core\Regex` member (`compile`, `match`, `matchAll`, `matches`,
`replace`, `replaceWith`, `split`, `quote`) has its description, three examples, an attack, a bench
and a Rust test with a `covers:` marker. All eight cards are in the plain voice, and the perf rows
for all eight were recorded after the last edit to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs`. The next edit
to that file makes them stale again. `dossier-core-regex` should be green. `split` now hands each
piece to the array as it arrives (`each_piece`), with no `Vec` of every piece first. Its attack
found a real overshoot, recorded as gap `nvs-stdlib/regex-split-builds-its-array-past-the`: the
array grows past the memory limit because `NvsArray::append` asks no budget. The attack still
passes, because a fatal memory-limit error is a clean end. `Core\Regex\Match` and
`Core\Regex\Pattern` are still listed in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.

items.text: **`Core\Regex\Match`'s class card** — the `dossier-core-regex-match` check: a `ClassDoc` above the class's `CLASS` row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs:586`, and delete the class from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283` (`rule:core-api/reference-card`). `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Regex\Match::text'` prints what each member owes.

**`Core\Regex\Match::groups`, `offset` and `text` proofs** — about, three examples, an attack, a bench and a second case each (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). An instance member needs a `// covers:` marker, even on a `.nvst` that already calls it. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs:1776` `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs:1806`

**Record the rows** — `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Regex\Match'` after the last edit to `regex.rs`, then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Regex'` again, because that edit makes the `Core\Regex` rows stale. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs:586`

**`split`'s array growth** — gap `nvs-stdlib/regex-split-builds-its-array-past-the`: ask the budget before each append in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs:2072`. The runtime's check is the private `NvsArray::affords_write` at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/array.rs:950`, so a producer needs a public seam. Take this only if the `Match` slices leave room.

backlog: `Core\Regex\Pattern` is still in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`), with no members of its own to prove.
`Core\Regex::matches` bench records a two-allocation gap against `allocations 0` (known-gap in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`).
Every `Core` member that appends in a loop over input has the same array growth past the limit as `split` (gap `nvs-stdlib/regex-split-builds-its-array-past-the`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs`).
